description: This file contains the implementation of a Hashicorp Vault secret manager class, which includes methods for authentication, reading, writing, deleting secrets, and constructing Vault API URLs. It interacts with Hashicorp Vault via HTTPX clients, supporting multiple authentication methods and secret management functionalities.

classes.name: HashicorpSecretManager
classes.description: A class that manages secrets within Hashicorp Vault, supporting authentication, secret reading and writing, and URL construction for secret access.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the HashicorpSecretManager instance, setting configuration parameters, validating credentials, and setting up cache.

methods.name: None _verify_required_credentials_exist(self)
methods.description: Validates that at least one authentication credential (token or AppRole) exists.

methods.name: str _auth_via_approle(self)
methods.description: Authenticates to Vault using the AppRole method, possibly using cached token.

methods.name: str _auth_via_tls_cert(self)
methods.description: Authenticates to Vault using TLS client certificate and key, returning a token.

methods.name: str get_url( self, secret_name: str, namespace: Optional[str] = None, mount_name: Optional[str] = None, path_prefix: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the Vault URL for accessing a secret based on parameters such as secret name, namespace, mount, and path prefix.

methods.name: Optional[str] _sanitize_plain_value(self, value: Optional[Union[str, int]])
methods.description: Sanitizes an input value to a string, removing whitespace and nulls.

methods.name: Optional[str] _sanitize_path_component( self, value: Optional[Union[str, int]] )
methods.description: Sanitizes path components by removing surrounding slashes.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _extract_secret_manager_settings( self, optional_params: Optional[dict] )
methods.description: Extracts specific secret manager settings from optional parameters.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_secret_target( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] )
methods.description: Builds target information (URL and data key) necessary for secret operations.

methods.name: dict _get_request_headers(self)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate authentication header for Vault API requests based on available credentials.

methods.name: Optional[str] async_read_secret( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a secret from Hashicorp Vault.

methods.name: Optional[str] sync_read_secret( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Synchronously reads a secret from Hashicorp Vault.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] async_write_secret( self, secret_name: str, secret_value: str, description: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, tags: Optional[Union[dict, list]] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a secret to Hashicorp Vault.

methods.name: Dict async_rotate_secret( self, current_secret_name: str, new_secret_name: str, new_secret_value: str, optional_params: Dict | None = None, timeout: float | httpx.Timeout | None = None, )
methods.description: Placeholder method for secret rotation, not supported by Vault.

methods.name: dict async_delete_secret( self, secret_name: str, recovery_window_in_days: Optional[int] = 7, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes (marks as deleted) a secret in Vault.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_secret_value_from_json_response( self, json_resp: Optional[dict] )
methods.description: Parses the JSON response from Vault to extract the stored secret value.
